item:
Studio "Follow live": a toggle in a project's 3D view (off by default); while on, `git fetch` at most every 60 s, fast-forward (clean tree only, else "can't update: local changes" and stop) when origin commits touch projects/

/, rebuild ONLY the changed parts (geometry + meshes, no checks), swap them into the viewer in place with the camera kept, highlight ~2 s, one line with the commit subject + time; a part that fails mid-edit keeps its last good mesh ("being edited"); placeholders "being designed"; no timeline/scrubber; tests
